pain_point: Cash flow concerns during construction - If I buy off the plan when do I actually start paying? I can't afford rent AND a mortgage at the same time
primary_text: "I can't afford rent AND a mortgage at the same time." You don't have to. Off-the-plan works differently from buying an existing property. You secure your Truganina warehouse with a deposit — typically 10%. Then you pay nothing further until the build is complete and you settle. During construction, you stay in your current premises and keep paying rent as normal. When the warehouse is ready, you settle, move in, and your mortgage replaces your rent. No overlap. No double payments. No cash flow crisis. It's why off-the-plan is the smartest path for owner-occupiers. Request the payment schedule and see exactly how it works.
description: 10% deposit secures your warehouse — no further payments until completion
